name: Plum in the Snow (Tuyết Trung Mai)
lore: A grey sword of tiger-stripe iron from the mountain above Thạch Khẩu Trấn, forged by Trác Thiết Cán in 1163, the winter after the school took the empty ore town. A single plum blossom is etched where the blade meets the guard. Lăng Đạp Tuyết had carried a plain iron sword for ninety years before it.
build_use: The founder's sword: critical thrusts and Wood bleeds, a Metal sword that flowers.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Hide of the Thạch Khẩu Tiger (Thạch Khẩu Hổ Bì Giáp)
lore: The striped hide of the spirit tiger that took the last miners of Thạch Khẩu Trấn (V053) and, a year later, Lăng Đạp Tuyết's daughter. Lăng killed it on Hổ Khiếu Cương in 1162 and would not touch the skin. Trác Thiết Cán, whose family were miners of the town, tanned it and wears it.
build_use: The smith's armour: a heavy body and a hide that beasts remember.

name: Snow Cloak of Hàn Mai (Hàn Mai Tuyết Bào)
lore: White felt with a plum branch stitched on the back in iron thread. The village of Hàn Mai gave it to him the winter he founded the school, from the wool of every house.
build_use: The branch under the blossom: health and heavier crits.
